name: Brainbees Solutions Ltd
title: Brainbees Solutions Ltd - 544226 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: India multi-channel GMV +11% with diapering price war cutting gross margin ~140 bps; management guides FY27 growth superior to FY26 and says margin loss recovers from Q2, but no capacity or supply signals.

capex.quote: we wanted to maintain capital efficiency, and that's the reason we are kind of paused opening of company owned stores in FY26

triggers.label: Diapering discounting cut GM ~140 bps
triggers.quote: we had close to 140 bps of gross margin. Margin pressure that we saw in Q3 which has continued

triggers.label: Quick-commerce price war, 4-6 quarters
triggers.quote: we believe that its probably a 4-6 quarters sort of a phenomena. It'll go away.

triggers.label: FY27 growth to beat FY26
triggers.quote: we remain fairly, I would say, confident of the FY27 growth will be much superior than the FY26

triggers.label: ~100 stores planned in FY27 after ~10 in FY26
triggers.quote: we should be opening roughly 100 stores in this year

guidance.quote: FY27 India multi-channel GMV growth will be much superior than the FY26
we should be opening roughly 100 stores in this year

guidance.metric: Qwik share of B2C online shipments
guidance.quote: our Qwik deliveries over entire B2C shipments should cross roughly around 10% of our overall online business

red_flags.label: Quick-commerce diaper price war compressing margins
red_flags.quote: there's a price competition which is resulting into this loss as of now

red_flags.label: Management says drop in sales from Middle East uncertainty
red_flags.quote: it has been a little bit of a moderation in consumer sentiment

evasions.quote: It's too early to comment on that but I think that this is going to be a meaningful outcome
we haven't really thought through it yet as well
